is_durable.instructions: Would knowing this save time or prevent the same mistake in a future session?

is_failure.instructions: Does this describe an error, failure, or pitfall encountered and how it was resolved?

has_secret.instructions: Does this text contain a password, API key, token, or other credential that must NOT be stored in memory?

is_session_scoped.instructions: Does this instruction or preference explicitly apply only to the current session or task?

importance.instructions: How important is it to remember this in long-term memory?

target.instructions: Which memory category does this belong to?

criteria.user: Who the user is, preferences, communication style
criteria.failure: Failures, errors, corrections, lessons learned and tool quirks
